tools.name: get_prayer_times
tools.description: Daily prayer times (Fajr, sunrise, Dhuhr, Asr, Maghrib, Isha) for a city or coordinates, for a date or up to 31 days, with the Hijri date.

place.description: City name, optionally with country ("Kuala Lumpur", "London, United Kingdom"), or a neighbourhood or landmark in HalalTrip's listings ("Bugis, Singapore"). For other areas, give coordinates.

latitude.description: Latitude in degrees, instead of place.

longitude.description: Longitude in degrees, instead of place.

method.description: Calculation method id from list_calculation_methods. Default: the method of the country's Islamic authority (MUIS, JAKIM, Diyanet, ...), else Muslim World League.

asr.description: Asr juristic method. Default: Hanafi in Pakistan, India, Bangladesh and Afghanistan, else Shafii.

date.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today at the place.

tools.name: get_ramadan_timetable
tools.description: Sahur (ends at Fajr) and iftar (Maghrib) times for every day of this or the next Ramadan in a city, with the expected or announced first day and Eid al-Fitr.

place.description: City name, optionally with country ("Kuala Lumpur", "London, United Kingdom"), or a neighbourhood or landmark in HalalTrip's listings ("Bugis, Singapore"). For other areas, give coordinates.

latitude.description: Latitude in degrees, instead of place.

longitude.description: Longitude in degrees, instead of place.

method.description: Calculation method id from list_calculation_methods. Default: the method of the country's Islamic authority (MUIS, JAKIM, Diyanet, ...), else Muslim World League.

asr.description: Asr juristic method. Default: Hanafi in Pakistan, India, Bangladesh and Afghanistan, else Shafii.

tools.name: get_qibla_direction
tools.description: The Qibla bearing (direction of the Kaaba in Mecca) from a city or coordinates, in degrees from true north, with the distance.

place.description: City name, optionally with country ("Kuala Lumpur", "London, United Kingdom"), or a neighbourhood or landmark in HalalTrip's listings ("Bugis, Singapore"). For other areas, give coordinates.

latitude.description: Latitude in degrees, instead of place.

longitude.description: Longitude in degrees, instead of place.

tools.name: get_islamic_calendar
tools.description: The Hijri date for a day, the next key Islamic dates (Ramadan, Eid al-Fitr, Day of Arafah, Eid al-Adha, Islamic New Year, ...) and month starts announced by Islamic authorities.

country.description: Two-letter ISO country code (SG, MY, GB, ...) to use that country's announced dates. Default: Umm al-Qura (Saudi Arabia).

tools.name: find_halal_restaurants
tools.description: Halal restaurants near a city or coordinates, nearest first, with each one's CHDA halal assurance code in words (who stands behind the halal status, the kitchen, alcohol), cuisines, HalalTrip Gastronomy Awards and its HalalTrip page.

place.description: City name, optionally with country ("Kuala Lumpur", "London, United Kingdom"), or a neighbourhood or landmark in HalalTrip's listings ("Bugis, Singapore"). For other areas, give coordinates.

latitude.description: Latitude in degrees, instead of place.

longitude.description: Longitude in degrees, instead of place.

halal.description: Only restaurants with a halal certificate, or certified or Muslim-owned. Default any.

radius_km.description: How far to look, in km (1 to 25). Default 5.

limit.description: How many places, 1 to 10, nearest first. Default 5.

tools.name: find_places_to_pray
tools.description: Mosques and prayer rooms (musholla, surau) near a city or coordinates, nearest first, with listed facilities (Jumu'ah, women's prayer area, wudu) and each one's HalalTrip page.

place.description: City name, optionally with country ("Kuala Lumpur", "London, United Kingdom"), or a neighbourhood or landmark in HalalTrip's listings ("Bugis, Singapore"). For other areas, give coordinates.

latitude.description: Latitude in degrees, instead of place.

longitude.description: Longitude in degrees, instead of place.

kind.description: Mosques only, prayer rooms only, or both. Default both.

facilities.description: Only places listing all of these: jumuah (Friday prayers), women (women's prayer area), wudu (ablution facilities).

radius_km.description: How far to look, in km (1 to 25). Default 5.

limit.description: How many places, 1 to 10, nearest first. Default 5.

tools.name: get_airport_prayer_rooms
tools.description: The prayer rooms inside one airport: terminal, where in the terminal, airside or landside, opening hours and where the details come from (often the airport operator).

airport.description: The airport's three-letter IATA code ("SIN", "DXB") or its name ("Heathrow").

tools.name: get_inflight_prayer_times
tools.description: Prayer times during a flight, worked out along the route at cruising altitude: which prayers fall in the air (in both airports' local time), which before departure and after arrival, and the Qibla relative to the aircraft's nose. On flights to Jeddah, also the miqat where pilgrims intending Hajj or Umrah must be in ihram. Flights up to 20 hours. The flight is either a flight number with its departure date (the airline's scheduled airports and times, looked up here), or the airports and local times. With a flight number, also the airline's halal meal policy.

flight_number.description: Flight number, for example "SQ308". With flight_date, the airports and times are looked up; a flight with a stop is one leg at a time (from_airport or to_airport picks it).

flight_date.description: Departure date at the departure airport, YYYY-MM-DD, with flight_number.

from_airport.description: Departure airport: IATA code ("SIN") or name.

departure_local.description: Departure in the departure airport's local time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm.

to_airport.description: Arrival airport: IATA code ("LHR") or name.

arrival_local.description: Arrival in the arrival airport's local time, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm.

method.description: Calculation method id from list_calculation_methods. Default: the method of the departure country's Islamic authority, else Muslim World League.

asr.description: Asr juristic method. Default: Hanafi when departing from Pakistan, India, Bangladesh or Afghanistan, else Shafii.

tools.name: list_calculation_methods
tools.description: The prayer time calculation methods HalalTrip supports, with the ids to pass as method.
